claims_and_limits: Fraunhofer's October 23 report describes a tested 10-qubit system accessible to users and a 30-qubit system still under testing.
Cryogenic CMOS characterization and interposer packaging connect quantum and control chips while addressing signal and heat constraints.
Fault tolerance, computational advantage, manufacturing yield and repeated system-level reliability are not established by the release. Suggested evaluation measurements are editorial assessment.

visual.central_question: What must work together to scale a quantum computer beyond processor qubit count?
visual.shared_motif: A conceptual chip-to-control connection in blue-cyan with warm copper traces; precise apparatus is not depicted.
visual.infographic_argument: The processor, interposer and control electronics, assembled demonstrator and repeatable machine are successive questions; the final machine is a goal, not a reported milestone.
visual.status: Conceptual artwork. The 10-qubit tested/access milestone and 30-qubit testing milestone are separately labelled. Native image and 1200x630 crop inspected.
